rootCauseAnalysis.failurePoint: spawn-preparer.js prepareAndQueueSpawn() — UC status check only gated on 'complete', allowing tasks tied to blocked_human/blocked_external UCs to proceed to spawn
rootCauseAnalysis.why: The UC status check at spawn time was added to prevent spawning against already-complete UCs, but the equivalent guard for terminal-blocked UCs (blocked_human, blocked_external) was never added. Tasks created before a UC was marked blocked remain in 'ready' status and get spawned repeatedly, burning budget with guaranteed failures.
rootCauseAnalysis.fix: Added hard-skip in prepareAndQueueSpawn() immediately after the 'complete' check: if uc.implementation_status is 'blocked_human' or 'blocked_external', mark task as 'blocked' and return null. Committed to ~/projects/genome @ 59fd370.
